Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 7
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner introduced a faulty “normalization” rule to convert any mention of “Papal States” into “Rome” and even to prefer sources that mention “Rome.” This conflates a historical polity with a specific city and biases the search toward an incorrect location. Reliable sources indicate Girolamo Riario (Bianca Riario’s father) was assassinated in Forlì, not Rome; the Planner’s instruction would misreport the correct death place.
